## Sources

## Description

The input has one designated `PRODUCT` as assembly root; on re-export, a different (component) `PRODUCT` is emitted as the root and the original root is missing or now subordinate. The semantic owner of the assembly is changed. Bug-reporter language: "wrong root product after re-export", "STEP swapped which part is top", "assembly root re-rooted".

## Reproducer recipe

a NAUO chain rooted on `'screw'` with `'plate'` as a component, when comment notes input was rooted on `'plate'`.

## Expected kernel behavior

preserve the input's choice of assembly root; document a tie-break rule when the input has multiple unconnected products.

## Notes

Distinct kernel-branch from Wr024 (flattening) — this preserves depth but rotates the tree.
